sections.heading: Introduction
sections.text: Key Partner is a Quest in Escape from Tarkov.

sections.heading: Dialogue
sections.text: "So a birdie told me the driver is determined and is looking for a new employer. I doubt the idiot realizes all the consequences of such a transition. In any case, I never even gave him that option anyway! The only lead I've confirmed now is about Peacekeeper. You should go to him and remind him that we have common interests with him! Make him remember who his key partner is."

sections.heading: Requirements
sections.text: - Unlocks 6 hours after completion of Hindsight 20/20

sections.heading: Rewards
sections.text:
- +28,000 EXP
- 1,650 Euros
  - 1,732 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 1
  - 1,897 Euros with Intelligence Center Level 2
- 2× Intelligence folder
"Peacekeeper is a forward thinker, even if he wants to seem like a simple hustler. He won't dare to go against me now."

sections.heading: Guide
sections.text:
In this quest you have to sell any 75 items to Peacekeeper, with the exception of ammunition.

The sales amount display may not always update immediately. A game restart forces a refresh.
